This FloPlast solvent weld end ventilation collar is an essential component for 110mm soil and vent pipe systems, designed to ensure a robust and watertight seal. Constructed from high quality uPVC, it provides lasting durability for various drainage installations. The collar solvent welds securely just above the end ventilation slate, deflecting water away from the pipe's exterior. This design detail is crucial for preventing water ingress and maintaining system integrity, making it ideal for both new build plumbing projects and critical repair work across various properties.
